aiVerification.summary: Workbook appears to compare HÀNG TEST vs HÀNG THƯỜNG across SPL, IMP, and THD, but the draft misstates the changed factor and has unreliable measurement stats.
issues: Changed factor is filename instead of test vs normal condition.
Baseline and changed conditions are left unclear despite header evidence.
Measurement stats appear contaminated by sample/index labels, shown by min value 1.0.
Outcome metric is generic and does not preserve SPL, IMP, THD as separate metrics.
Numeric outcomes cite only header rows, not measurement data rows.
requiredUserQuestions: What actual product/process/material difference does HÀNG TEST represent?
Should HÀNG THƯỜNG be treated as the baseline condition?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to HÀNG TEST vs HÀNG THƯỜNG with HÀNG THƯỜNG as baseline if confirmed.
Use SPL, IMP, and THD as separate outcome metrics under one comparison context.
Recompute stats excluding Standard and sample-number header cells.
Cite representative data rows for each metric, not only condition headers.
Replace raw row title with a concise comparison title.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Condition header citations are sufficient for grouping, but outcome evidence citations and computed stats are not sufficient.
